I wrote the solution to `main.wj`. I ran it in the interpreter on both examples plus one extra line, and the output was correct. I didn't run `wj build`, as instructed, so the compiled path is untested.

The extra line was `-7 2 /`, which gave `-3`, so division truncates toward zero.

It stops at the first error on each line, scanning left to right. Blank and whitespace-only lines are skipped. A b
